lines: This tiny engine beats an LLM. And it's 11× faster.
Zürich to London on Google Flights. In just 7.1 seconds.
Wait for useful state only. Capped at a hundred milliseconds.
Median task time dropped by twenty-five percent. Protocol calls fell from one thousand to a hundred.
One request per decision cycle. Operation and target share the state.
Atomic DOM snapshots with freshness guards. No site-specific scripts needed.
Small enough to read. One agent file handles the complete loop.
Tests run offline with no external dependencies. Just clone, sync, and go.
Give it one goal in natural language. Jev picks the operation automatically.
Dynamic, indexed action space for any web page. Built on Python and MIT licence.
